detail.title: Path Dependence and Divergent Values: Experimental Refinement
detail.summary: The previous experiment (exp-divergent-values-test-91) failed to reach the target divergence threshold of 0.3, yielding 0.028. This suggests the coupling coefficient of 0.95 or the noise baseline normalization may be masking divergence. A revised hypothesis and new experimental protocol will test lower coupling ranges and adjusted noise normalization parameters.
